newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Csopak hits record high after acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Csopak hits record high after acquisition.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian holding company Csopak Szovetkezeti Rt closed at a new record high on Tuesday, after the East European Food Fund acquired an over 30-percent stake in the company.
Csopak shares opened at 1,155 forints, below Monday's close of 1,165 forints, and rose to a new record of 1,240 forints.
"The price rise was evidently the result of the purchase," one trader said.
Csopak officials announced on Monday that its shareholders approved U.K.-based East European Food Fund acquiring a just over 30 percent stake in Csopak.

Making its third investment in Hungary, the fund subscribed the whole of a 700-million-forint private share issue which brought Csopak's issued share capital to 2.2 billion. The 1,000-forint face value shares were issued at 1,150 forints.
